name: Just Cube and Go Pangasinan 2025
information: You don't have to do other things, Just Cube and Go! # **IMPORTANT REMINDER** Although this is a free competition, you still need to secure your slot by paying a "securing fee" which costs Php 300.00. To refund the payment, you MUST attend the competition. Just approach Kuya Xavier, the organizer, for the refund. Failing to attend the competition may open slots for walk-ins. ​ ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NDg4OTMsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--dd8f31a5987d34a734158346c72c137e514bc738/Just%20Cube%20and%20GO.png)
